title: FBI-UAP-D021, Digital Rendering, Narrative Statement 1-3, Western United States Event, 2023
doc_notes: This document is a digital rendering and narrative statement created by the FBI in 2026 based on a 2023 UAP sighting reported by a federal law enforcement agent.

incidents.summary: A glowing orange-red celestial body, resembling a blood moon, was observed over a mountain ridge near a sensitive national security site.
incidents.quote: A large, glowing orange-red celestial body, resembling a blood moon
